steps.note: Observe current screen to determine app state
Open Chrome and use its address bar as a text field to copy the text
Observe Chrome screen and find address bar
Type the text into the search box, then long press to select and copy
Long press the address bar text to open the selection menu and choose Copy
Open the selection overflow menu to choose Select all before copying
Tap Copy in the selection toolbar, then verify by pasting
Long press the url bar again to get the selection toolbar with Copy
Close the Select to Speak overlay and retry long press for Copy
Long press url bar to select text, then tap Copy at (241,372)
Tap Copy, then paste into the address bar to verify clipboard content
Clear the address bar, then paste to verify the clipboard holds the text
Long press the empty address bar to show Paste, then paste to read clipboard content
Tap Paste and read the resulting url_bar text to verify clipboard
Clear the temp text from Chrome and finish
